messages:
maya: Heads-up — the README curl example has a wrapped Authorization header; copy-pasting into terminals breaks the header and causes 401s.
maya: Here's the block from README:
maya: ```
curl https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" \
  --data '{\"prompt\":\"hi\"}'
```
maya: On GitHub it renders with soft-wrap and when people copy it the `-H` line sometimes gets split across lines.
maya: People hit this all week in support.

tim: Oof, seen that. Quick fix: recommend using single quotes for the header on Mac/Linux or the long-form --header, and show a one-line example.
tim: Example one-liner:

```
curl -sS -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate --data '{\"prompt\":\"hi\"}'
```

tim: Also add a PowerShell example — double quotes behave differently there.

anna: PowerShell snippet I sent to support:

```
$body = '{\"prompt\":\"hi\"'}
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate' -Method Post -Headers @{ Authorization = \"Bearer $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY\"; 'Content-Type'='application/json' } -Body $body
```

anna: I'll open a small PR to change the README and include both one-line curl and PS examples.

maya: Thanks. Can we also add a note about not pasting into fish shell where `$REDWOOD_API_KEY` needs braces? small footnote.

devex-bot: Created issue #4321: `docs: fix curl header line-wrapping and add PowerShell example` — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/4321 :white_check_mark:

tim: I'll review the PR once it's up. :thumbsup:

maya: Patch LGTM after tests. :shipit:
